blocks.html: Rooftops used for recreational purposes shall be provided with wire fencing at least 10 feet (3048 mm) in height. Openings in the fence shall not permit the passage of a 4-inch (101.6 mm) diameter sphere. Where ball games are played on rooftops the wire fencing shall be extended to provide an overhead closure.
